findings.text: blocking: retention_sweep, reached by 'crew retention-sweep --project P' (reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2207), calls _orphan_ledger_indexes(apply=apply, now=moment, report_removals=True) with no project and no repo, so project=None takes the unscoped branch and every orphan ledger index in the shared crew cache is still pruned whatever project the caller names; the goal and the plan's deliverable name the ledger-index sweep, so the reclaim the section exists to prevent remains reachable on this entry point.

blocking: the landed scoping turns this assertion red at head - gates/sibling-head.log records 'assert 2 == 3' EXIT=1 and 4 failed against 1 at sibling-base - as it does at tests/test_gc_reaches_every_crew_store.py:436 ('assert not True' for the unattributable directory) and tests/test_gc_sweeps_ledger_indexes.py:129, so the plan's done-when clause that importing test files add no failure against the base revision is unmet and the merged suite goes red until these three expectations are updated under a scope extension.

non-blocking: _manifest_project duplicates the manifest read reckon/crew/reports.py:318 parse_manifest already owns, branching on the same lstrip().startswith('{') test as reports.py:349 and re-implementing the tolerant key: value read, where a try/except around parse_manifest would extend the owner.

non-blocking: after_suite declares revision 5414c5de36 while the gate script recorded 'git rev-parse HEAD' at run time and the cited gates/after-suite.log header reads e4f4dbf2c7, so the record names a revision the log was not run at; only the docs fragment differs, but a reader comparing revisions against promotion cannot tell that.

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified four production call sites: crew gc via crew_run_commands.py:2308 into garbage_collect, the two sweep invocations at gc.py:1249 and gc.py:1262, and crew retention-sweep via crew_run_commands.py:2207 into gc.py:2209.
item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against base 042d4a27f: e4f4dbf2c7 adds 120 lines to routing.py (five attribution helpers and the keep branch), 45 to gc.py (project/repo parameters and attribution), and a 184-line test; 5414c5de36 adds a 25-line evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names tests/test_gc_reclaims_only_its_projects_entries via tests/test_gc_reclaims_only_its_project.py; the gate logs record base red (gates/negative-control.log) and head green (gates/after-suite.log, 56 passed EXIT=0), but the done-when clause that importing test files add no failure against base is not met: gates/sibling-head.log reads 4 failed against 1 at base, three added (test_gc_reaches_every_crew_store.py:250, :436, tests/test_gc_sweeps_ledger_indexes.py:129).
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to scope gc's unledgered, ledger-index and run-lock sweeps to the project they run for; routing.py:2270-2317 and gc.py:599-672 now attribute run directories and ledger indexes and keep a peer's entries, the run-lock sweep is already scoped by the project-built ledgered set (routing.py:2049), but the same index sweep is still unscoped on the retention path (gc.py:2209).
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits e4f4dbf2c7 and 5414c5de36, tests and test_logs naming five gate logs, negative_control_log set, baseline_suite and after_suite recorded, outside_scope naming three sibling failures, blockers stated as none while its own text says a done-when clause cannot be met.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read prompt.txt:80-85: routing.py, gc.py, tests/test_gc_reclaims_only_its_project.py, the evidence fragment and a figures directory; the diff touches the first four and nothing outside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_gc_reclaims_only_its_project.py:150-158 asserts the peer directory's action stays 'keep' at the base revision, where gates/negative-control.log:56 records 'assert \'prune\' == \'keep\'', so the assertion reddens on exactly the regression it guards; the retention-path gap at reckon/crew/gc.py:2209 has no test.
justifications.evidence: gates/negative-control.log (rev 042d4a27f) reads "1 failed" EXIT=1 with 'assert \'prune\' == \'keep\'' and gates/after-suite.log reads "56 passed" EXIT=0, while the manifest's after_suite names revision 5414c5de36 against a log header of e4f4dbf2c7 and gates/sibling-head.log reads "4 failed" EXIT=1 against "1 failed" at sibling-base (gates/sibling-base.log), three added.
justifications.fit: the added helpers in reckon/crew/routing.py:2095-2190 follow the module's private-helper and docstring idiom and carry no plan, ticket or stage identifier, matching reckon/crew/routing.py:2018-2028.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/gc.py:1249-1266 passes project and repo into both scoped sweeps, but reckon/crew/gc.py:2209 calls _orphan_ledger_indexes from retention_sweep with no project, so the project-scoped path at reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2207 still reclaims peer projects' ledger indexes.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/routing.py:2131 _manifest_project re-implements the two-format manifest read that reckon/crew/reports.py:318 parse_manifest already owns, including the same 'starts with {' branch at reports.py:349.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat e4f4dbf2c7^..5414c5de36 touches only reckon/crew/routing.py, reckon/crew/gc.py, tests/test_gc_reclaims_only_its_project.py and the evidence fragment, every one inside the node's declared write paths from prompt.txt:80-85.
